positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Enhanced the development team’s production environment by authoring technical documentation for newly developed Flutter components 
•	Modeled an LLM agent and automation flow with full tracing capabilities for transparency into tool calling and decision-making
•	Engineered and executed backend test suites using pytest to identify and remediate critical issues in the mobile application’s Flask backend
•	Architected a personalized workout recommendation system utilizing OpenAI's GPT SDK and developing a RESTful API using a Flask backend
•	Led database schema redesign for production Postgres SQL database and integrated into an updated Web API
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Full-Stack Development · Front-End Development · Flask · Model-View-Controller (MVC) · API Development · Database Design

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated on interdisciplinary teams, guiding design projects from ideation to production, applying engineering principles, and problem-solving skills.
- Utilized Python, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn to analyze project ROI, establishing a strong basis for project prioritization.
- Consulted daily with internal customers, developing specialized solutions to a variety of mechanical design challenges.
- Led a large-scale stanchion production project, successfully reducing assembly costs by 30% and significantly improving ergonomic conditions for technicians.
- Created and produced over 50 3D-printed components, further developing skills in rapid prototyping and design.
- Conducted regular design reviews and employed project management strategies, including Gantt charts, FMEA analysis, and stakeholder management, to ensure projects were executed in a timely manner.
positions.insights: Skills: Product Design · Cost Reduction · Mechanical Engineering · Rapid Prototyping · Communication · SOLIDWORKS · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Design · Statistics

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Conducted a Design of Experiments to minimize diameter variability in carbon filter production, enhancing yield and reducing overhead costs
- Created 10+ work instruction documents, outlining process standards for quality assurance technicians
- Redesigned molds for production parts using SolidWorks, enhancing safety and ergonomics within the production processes
- Developed process flow charts and time studies to identify bottlenecks and boost production efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Data Analysis · Quality Assurance · Design of Experiments (DOE) · Statistics

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded Modif Media, a dynamic video editing collaboration company that was selected for inclusion in Georgia Tech's Create X Startup Program
- Utilized Final Cut Pro software to create 20+ high-quality promotional videos for local Atlanta startups
- Secured an investment of $20,000 from Georgia Tech's Create X program, effectively valuing Modif Media at $400,000
- Served as the primary liaison between site users and the software development team, providing crucial user experience feedback to inform and enhance software improvements

positions.title: Product Sustaining Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to design modifications for a collaborative cost saving project that saved ~ $1M in annual costs
- Implemented engineering design changes using SolidWorks to sustain product manufacturability and quality
- Created bill of materials for newly modified production parts
positions.insights: Skills: Cost Reduction · Communication · SOLIDWORKS · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Quality Assurance
